newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 20.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Nomura Securities Co Ltd's former president Hideo Sakamaki served another arrest warrant over 320 million yen payment to corporate racketeer.
-- Commercial and regional banks to start joint experiment for electronic money.
-- Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto vows to draft framework for reorganisation of ministries and agencies by late August.
-- Denver summit declaration to call for Russia's integration into internationl economy.
-- Japan to announce food aid to North Korea this month.
-- Typhoon may hit central and eastern Japan.
-- Prime Minister Hashimoto to hold talks with U.S. President Bill Clinton.
